title: Zesty Umami Canadian Beef Poutine
description: A Whole30-friendly Canadian dish featuring long-fermentation-dough and pink food colouring, perfect for midnight cravings. This umami-rich poutine is made with pillowy dough and tender beef.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the long-fermentation-dough to a thickness of about 1 inch.
Cut the dough into 1-inch cubes and fry in ghee or coconut oil until golden brown.
In a separate pan, cook the sliced beef in a little ghee or coconut oil until browned.
Add the beef broth to the pan with the beef and bring to a simmer.
Add the arrowroot powder to the broth and stir to thicken.
Add the cheese curds to the broth and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the fried dough cubes to the broth and stir to coat.
Season with sea salt to taste.
If desired, add a few drops of pink food colouring to tint the dish.
